tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background — warm cream like a wedding invitation card.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the hall-entry form.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ooru, relation, timestamps, helper text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and input borders at rest.

tokens.name: kumkum
tokens.usage: Brand and primary action (Save entry, Share link). Kumkum red — the colour of auspicious beginnings.

tokens.name: on-kumkum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on kumkum fills.

tokens.name: manjal
tokens.usage: Turmeric accent: highlights, gold/silver gift markers, the running total band. Never for body text; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: ilai
tokens.usage: Banana-leaf green: confirmed entries, success, synced state.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending guest submissions and unsynced (offline) entries. Always paired with an icon or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, reject, errors. Use sparingly — distinct from kumkum by always carrying a label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows' text lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; kolam dot pitch.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, list rows and inputs in hall mode — older users, crowded hall, one hand.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the total band, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Mode selector pills (Cash / UPI / Gold / Gift).
